vehicle_classes.A: Light vehicle — height <= 2.8 m AND length <= 12.5 m (cars, motorcycles, small vans). Towing or roof load that breaches either dimension reclassifies to B.

notes: Prices are the published 1 July 2026 quarterly schedule unless a different effective_date is stated on the road.
Non-WestConnex Sydney motorways are indexed QUARTERLY (1 Jan / 1 Apr / 1 Jul / 1 Oct). WestConnex roads are indexed ANNUALLY on 1 January. Your ingest job must re-scrape on both cadences.
Do not hardcode these values in application code. Load from this file, version it, and treat a stale effective_date as a monitoring alert.
Authoritative per-trip pricing is the TfNSW Toll Calculator API v2. This file is the fallback / cross-check / offline table.
Records with confidence != "verified" MUST be confirmed before production use.

toll_roads.name: Hills M2 Motorway
toll_roads.description: Flat toll at the main toll point plus separate, cheaper ramp tolls. The range spans ramp toll to full main-line toll.

toll_roads.name: Military Road E-Ramp
toll_roads.description: Tolled ramp associated with the Lane Cove Tunnel concession.

toll_roads.name: Cross City Tunnel
toll_roads.description: Main tunnel toll plus cheaper portal/ramp tolls; range spans the two.

toll_roads.name: Westlink M7
toll_roads.description: Per-kilometre charge with a capped maximum trip toll. Min value is the shortest tolled movement, max is the trip cap.

toll_roads.name: NorthConnex
toll_roads.description: Same price both directions. Concession runs to 2048.

toll_roads.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge & Sydney Harbour Tunnel
toll_roads.description: Government-operated, time-of-day tolling, southbound only. Two-way tolling has been announced for a later year — re-check before launch.
toll_roads.verify_note: Source page listed both a pre-July and a from-1-July-2026 figure; the from-July values are used here. Confirm against the Toll Calculator API before production.
